## How to install

1. Download `OaModLauncher-{version}-windows-x64-setup.exe` below and run it.
2. Windows will say "Windows protected your PC", because the installer is not signed with a paid certificate. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Open the launcher and press **Install**. It puts BepInEx and OA Mod into your Golf With Your Friends folder and keeps the mod up to date. The launcher also updates itself.

Windows 10 or 11, 64 bit. No admin rights needed. You need your own copy of Golf With Your Friends on Steam.

**Remove mod** in the launcher puts the game back to how Steam installed it. OA Mod itself lives at https://github.com/Shironex/oa-mod

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the developers or the publisher of Golf With Your Friends. No warranty.
